exceptions.reason: Home Assistant 2026.8.1 requires cryptography==48.0.1 exactly; upgrading it independently would create an unsupported runtime.
exceptions.reachability: OIG and the supported Home Assistant paths do not call the affected PKCS7 decryption or X.509 verifier/path-builder APIs.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade with the first supported Home Assistant release that removes the exact cryptography 48.0.1 pin, then delete this exception.
